title: Unit Event — Find A Way Out — Episode3 Show Me The Illumination!

meta.Event Outline: Tis the season to be jolly and Vivid BAD SQUAD is all gathered at Weekend Garage. They discuss performing at the live house where RADder debuted, but Akito seems to have some history with said venue...

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, An, that's it for the tree!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, nice work!
We don't have that many ornaments, and it's not that big of a tree, so putting them up is usually a quick process.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But it's so pretty and cute!
It gives the shop a nice feel.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks! My mom picked everything out for us. She'll probably be super happy when she hears that you like it so much, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. You think so...?
And it looks like the lights all turned on with no problems!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thank goodness!
Alright, lemme go tell my dad.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks for helping out, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You're welcome! So, after this...
<Ah, so these are the decorations you all use...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: <Huh?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hello there!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Luka! What brings you here?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <It's almost Christmas, no?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I was just discussing with the others in SEKAI how we can transform MEIKO's cafe.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <So, I decided to come and see how you all decorate things during the season.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I see. Unfortunately, I'm not sure if we can help since we don't usually do much for our place.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Nonsense. That adorable little tree will make a wonderful example!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Still, you're right...
We want to decorate a little more than this... I wish there were more here that I could use as reference...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then, would you like to have a look outside?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, are you sure?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. Main Street has all these really cute shops, so those might help...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hey, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Uh oh... Kohane, hide that!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: What's wrong? You seem tense.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
N-Nothing's wrong!
Wait, actually. We finished decorating the tree!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, that's good to hear.
Then, can you start putting the outside decorations up?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Fine. I guess I am better at this than you. Also, our customers really like it when I do.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
I just don't have an eye for it.
Also, Kohane, thank you for helping out.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: N-No, it was my pleasure. You've already done so much for me.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Still, I feel bad about having you help out...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I know. Why don't you two sing?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yeah, since I just replaced all the equipment. You're probably going to like it a lot more compared to before.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, but today...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, let's sing for a little bit.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Then, you two rest while I get everything set up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks, Dad!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sorry, Luka...
We were hoping to show you some shops with decorations that you can use for reference...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<No, don't mind me!
I'm in no hurry whatsoever.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I know. Why don't I try visiting Akito and Toya while you two sing?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Toya said that he and his family are going to be throwing their Christmas party today.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, a party! That sounds lovely!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I might just have to go over and take a peek at what it's like.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Thank you for the tip, An, Kohane!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Have... Oh, she's already gone.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Did she leave to give us some time alone?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Maybe!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: At the same time, I've been wanting to sing ever since our after party...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I mean, Crawl Green...
It's where my dad and his team performed for the very first time. How can I not be excited?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Everyone's been saying just that, so it must be an amazing venue. It'd be great if I... If I could perform there with you guys...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There's no way we're leaving you out, Kohane! Well, to be fair, we still haven't booked the place...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: For now, let's just sing our hearts out!
Aoyagi Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Toya, would you like some coffee?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I would. Thank you, Mom.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Here, I also baked some scones and cookies.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It should be around noon in Germany right now.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, your brothers are probably getting ready for their concert.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: It's very rare for both of them to be performing in the same concert.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: By the way, Toya, how have you been lately...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We've begun hosting our own events recently, and we got to sing the song I wrote for the first time at one the other day.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Oh? You wrote a song?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: That explains why you've seemed so busy and have been coming home so late recently...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and our event ended up being very successful.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But above all else...
Seeing my friends all smile filled me with quite a bit of joy.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Why do you seem so satisfied...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Of course those closest to you will be happy with what you create. There wouldn't be much point in writing a song if you couldn't do at least that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But it was a big step for me...
I have a hard time calling my song pointless.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line:
Thank you. That was very good.
I'll be returning to my room now.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Okay, you're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm done as well.
I'll help you with the dishes.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: You will? Thank you, Toya.
Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, I have English homework to do.
I'll do it before I take my bath and...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hello, Toya! I let myself in♪>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Luka...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. You want to decorate MEIKO's cafe.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Our parties are usually fairly quiet, and we don't put up decorations, so I'm not sure if I'll be able to help...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<I see...
Oh, but you must've had some delicious food. Mind telling me what you ate?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We had roast chicken and rice gratin with fish. We also had some salad and pumpkin soup. My mom always puts a lot of effort into what we eat each year for this.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Oh, those all sound delicious!
I'll make sure to tell MEIKO... Thank you for sharing, Toya!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're welcome, but I wish I could help you more in terms of decorations...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Actually, you may want to pay Akito a visit...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He usually goes out for runs at this time, so you may be able to catch some outdoor illuminations.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Oh, really?!
Then, I'll do just that.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But it's so late in the day to be training. I suppose we shouldn't expect any less from hard-working Akito.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He's been like that since before I even met him.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Then, I think I'll go watch Akito train for a bit. And maybe see some illuminations for myself♪>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <See you later, Toya!>
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Here we are! Hello, Akito!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Akito...?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Wow, he's so focused. I don't think he heard me at all.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
(I probably shouldn't interrupt him...
Maybe I'll try again later when he decides to take a break.)

rows.Speaker: Local
rows.Line: Hey, look! The mascot for that shop's all dressed up for Christmas!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Uh oh... I need to hide before they see me.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Akito's probably blocking out all the sounds of this fun and vibrant city...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (You can do it, Akito...!)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Oh, that shop's lights! They're such a beautifully enchanting blue color!)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (And that shop over there... Is it supposed to be a snowman? Hehe. It's so cute!)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Whew... Hehe...
Lucky for me, I was able to place a reservation for that limited-edition transformation belt.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I was worried that they'd run out after everyone started talking about it online... I hope he likes it...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Hm? Isn't that...?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Hey, Akito! Hey, over here!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Mita...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What are you still doing here?
I thought you went home.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I was reserving my little brother's Christmas present. He's been wanting it for so long now...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Wait, you're all sweaty...
You haven't been training this whole time, have you?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I have. I don't want to waste a second...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
You never change, huh?
But we just had an after party. Can't you just take today off?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No way.
If anything, I should be doing more if I actually want to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And perform at Crawl Green...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If we really are gonna do an event there, we have to put on the best show we possibly can.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Which means I need to build my stamina, and do everything else in my power.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Right...
We actually might get a chance to play where RADder made their debut...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Hey, Akito...
Can I join you?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Join me...?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yeah, because you're right! If we're gonna perform there, I've gotta do more too!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Fine, whatever...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
*Cough* *Hack*
Huff... Huff...
W-Wait, I need to stop...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's take a break.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: S-Sorry, Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: All good. This is usually when I take a break, so here, have some water. It's still unopened.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: You sure? Thanks...
se_event_way_2022_002

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That hits the spot...
Still, Akito, we ran for a while. How are you not tired?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Because I do this every day.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Geez, that's unbelievable...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Then again, as far as I can remember, you've always had that sort of personality...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
How far back are you going...?
To be fair, I didn't expect to be part of your life for this long.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: When you decided to team up with Toya, I felt a sense of relief...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Because before you did, you tried to do everything yourself. I thought you'd be able to settle down a bit...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
By myself...? Yeah, I guess so...
You're probably one of the only people who really know what I was like back then.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A long time's passed since I began singing here...
